findings.message: Removing `await` from `this.saveUser(user)` causes the function to return `{ ok: true, userId: user.id }` before the user is actually persisted. If `saveUser` fails or throws, the error will be unhandled (or swallowed depending on the caller), and the caller will incorrectly believe the user was created successfully.
findings.suggestion: Restore `await` to ensure the user is saved before returning success: `await this.saveUser(user);`
